_comment: Kaveri Body Works is a fictional lorry-body manufacturer. Every company, person, vehicle number, amount and book entry here is synthetic.

company.name: Kaveri Body Works
company.business: Custom lorry bodies (platform, closed container, tipper) built on customers' chassis

_scenarios: PUR-2041/2042/2059: one bill split evenly across the three CT-104 bodies.
PUR-2047: square tube shared by CT-104 and CT-105; split taken from supplier bill CST/884.
EX-401: freight shared 4,000/2,000 between CT-104 and CT-105 per the expense book.
PUR-2053: paint 'for 104 & 105' with no split: NOTED_FOR both, charged to neither.
PUR-2056: duplicate of PUR-2055 struck out in the book (void): never counted.
PUR-2042, PUR-2031: partly paid supplier bills.
SP-307: cheque for PUR-2055 not cleared: payment unconfirmed.
PUR-2058: book says cash paid; no supplier payment applied (unreconciled).
SP-309: Rs 25,000 cash to Sri Balaji with no bill: unapplied payment.
WG-413: helper wages noted for 104/105 with no split.
WG-416: wage entry with the job column blank (unassigned labour).
WG-417: wage entry with the paid column blank (unknown payment status).
MC-403, MC-404, EX-404: workshop overheads with no allocation (policy decision).
EX-402: consumables with no contract allocation and no note.
MC-404: recorded on a loose slip only: no source record.
CT-102, CT-103, CT-104: customer balances outstanding; CT-101 fully received.
